description: This source file provides utilities for rasterizing PDF documents into PNG images using the PyMuPDF library (fitz). It defines a data class for page information, and a public function to perform the rasterization, returning image details and page dimensions.

classes.name: RasterPageInfo
classes.description: Data class to hold information about a rasterized page, including index, image path, dimensions in pixels, and DPI.

methods.name: Tuple[List[RasterPageInfo],Dict[int,Tuple[float,float]]] rasterize_pdf(pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Rasterizes the pages of a PDF document into PNG images at a given DPI, and records their sizes.
